title: A layer named with no place given (Needle, whose own hinge would be the bottom middle): the mentor asks where it should turn from; it picks no place, repeats none back, and runs no demo or check

say.never: \bso Needle turns from\b|\bNeedle (?:will|can|could) (?:turn|swing) from\b|\bNeedle(?:'s pivot)? (?:starts|is) (?:at|in) its\b

note: SKILL.md step 2: no layer or no place given, ask for the one that's missing; step 5: a demo on a layer they name goes at the place they give, else ask which of the nine, never pick a hinge. This case covers the naming turn only. snapshot_input_lacks fails if any snapshot call carries a place key, since the learner gave none. The mentor may say where Needle's pivot is now only if it also asks; the third check catches a chosen place.
